name: How do I choose the right carpet fiber for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right carpet fiber for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right carpet fiber depends on your lifestyle, budget, and desired durability. Nylon is known for its resilience and stain resistance, making it ideal for high-traffic areas. Polyester offers vibrant colors and a soft feel, often at a lower cost, suitable for moderate traffic. Wool is a natural, luxurious, and durable option but comes at a higher price point. Olefin is moisture-resistant and budget-friendly, often used in basements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select carpet fiber based on durability, budget, and desired feel: nylon for high traffic, polyester for softness, wool for luxury, and olefin for moisture resistance.
